entries.title: The lab log is open
entries.summary: Public record of results, progress, and failures from Dual R9700 speed and the hourly Idea lab. Empty cells stay empty. No invented tok/s.
entries.details:
This page is the living log for AMDai projects on the local desktop.

**Dual R9700 speed** is first: get Q4, Q5, and Q6 Flash-class models running as fast as possible on two R9700 cards. llama.cpp first. Q3 stays a labeled estimate. Q1/Q2 stay off.

**Idea lab** is the hourly notes stream — small experiments, dead ends, and next steps.

The table reads /data/lab-log.json in the browser so a server cron can refresh it without a rebuild.
entries.next: First Dual R9700 speed notes land when a measured card exists. Until then this log stays a progress note.
